selection: Prefer converged candidates meeting both unchanged development thresholds, then minimize design-weighted company-cross-fitted log loss, Brier and name. No held-out scores. Compare on exactly the frozen 303 development companies and weights.
training_weights: Alternative company normalization and three-year recency half-life affect training loss only. Population inclusion weights and all evaluation labels and weights remain unchanged.
limits: Repeated development selection is optimistic. This is a fixed research experiment, not independent validation or production approval.
